title: 택배가 없어요: 고객센터에 분실 항의하기
objective: Report a missing package and use -다면서요?.
summary: Call a delivery company about a package marked "delivered" that never came.
setting: A phone call to a delivery company's customer center. The app says the package was delivered yesterday, but the customer can't find it.

task.title: Report and complain
task.line: Use the words and the -다면서요? pattern from page 1 to answer each question.

words.meaning: 'You said … , right?' Use it to bring up what you were told and point out that it doesn't match what happened. Past: 갔다면서요. Future: 갈 거라면서요.
words.exampleMeaning: You said it would arrive today, right? It still hasn't come.

words.meaning: tracking number (printed on the shipping label)
words.example: 운송장 번호는 상자에 붙은 종이에 있어요.
words.exampleMeaning: The tracking number is on the label stuck to the box.

words.meaning: loss (of a package that went missing)
words.example: 택배가 분실된 것 같아서 고객센터에 전화했어요.
words.exampleMeaning: I think my package got lost, so I called the customer center.
Please come back and take the wrongly delivered item.

words.example: 분실 신고는 앱에서도 접수할 수 있어요.
words.exampleMeaning: You can also file a lost-package report in the app.

words.meaning: compensation (for a lost or damaged item)
words.example: 깨진 물건도 보상을 받을 수 있나요?
words.exampleMeaning: Can I get compensation for a broken item too?

dialogue.korean: 네, 고객센터입니다. 운송장 번호를 말씀해 주시겠어요?
dialogue.meaning: Hello, this is the customer center. Could you tell me your tracking number?

dialogue.korean: 5381-2207-6614예요. 문 앞에 두고 갔다면서요? 그런데 문 앞에 아무것도 없어요.
dialogue.meaning: It's 5381-2207-6614. You said it was left at my door, right? But there's nothing there.

dialogue.korean: 사진을 보니 옆 동 현관 앞인 것 같습니다. 바로 기사님께 확인해 보겠습니다.
dialogue.meaning: From the photo, it looks like the entrance of the next building. I'll check with the driver right away.

dialogue.korean: 지난달에도 다시는 이런 일이 없을 거라면서요. 이번이 벌써 두 번째예요.
dialogue.meaning: Last month you said this would never happen again. This is already the second time.

exercises: Choose the right form: 택배를 경비실에 (맡겼다면서요 / 맡긴다면서요)? 그런데 경비실에도 없대요. (The driver says he already left it.)
Write the right word from page 1: ① The box went to someone else's address. → 택배가 ____되었어요. ② 물건을 못 찾으면 ____을 받을 수 있어요. ③ 분실 신고는 앱에서도 ____할 수 있어요.
Answer in English: In the dialogue, where does the agent think the package was left?
Complain in Korean: Last time, the company promised the driver would call before delivery (배송 전에 전화하다). Use -(으)ㄹ 거라면서요?
answers: ① 오배송 ② 보상 ③ 접수
In front of the entrance of the next building (옆 동 현관 앞).
배송 전에 전화할 거라면서요? (지난번에 배송 전에 전화할 거라면서요? / 기사님이 배송 전에 전화하실 거라면서요?)
